section1.title: DELIVERY TIME <highlight>3-5 DAYS</highlight>
section1.description: Normally, after CCHAT receives the order information from the Customer, we will process the order <highlight>within 24 hours</highlight> and respond to the customer regarding payment and delivery.
section1.deliveryTimeInfo: The normal delivery time will be about <highlight>3-5 days</highlight> from the date the customer's order is confirmed or as agreed with the customer when ordering.

section2.delayIntro: However, there will also be cases where delivery is extended due to the following force majeure reasons:

delayReasons.reason1: CCHAT staff cannot contact the customer by phone, so they cannot <highlight>confirm the order</highlight> or hand it over to the shipping carrier.
delayReasons.reason2: The address or phone number provided by the customer is <highlight>incorrect</highlight>.
delayReasons.reason3: The number of orders at CCHAT is overloaded, causing order processing to be delayed.
delayReasons.reason4: The shipping partner encounters problems causing delivery to the customer to be delayed.

section2.deliveryAttempts: Customer orders will be delivered <highlight>a maximum of 3 times</highlight>. If the first delivery is unsuccessful, the delivery staff will contact you again after 1-2 business days. Therefore, if after 3 delivery attempts the order is still unsuccessful, the order will be cancelled.
section2.checkOrder: To check information or order status, please call Hotline <highlight>0868 506 800</highlight> for CCHAT customer service staff to check for you.
section2.checkProduct: You can completely check the product before receiving and paying the delivery staff. In case of any issues, please contact <highlight>0868 506 800</highlight> immediately for timely support.

hero.title:
DISCOVER
CCHAT
hero.descriptionPart2: fashion brand bringing youthfulness and confidence to modern women

timeline.title: OUR JOURNEY
timeline.description: In 2017, CCHAT opened its first store in Hanoi, marking the beginning of a mission to redefine modern fashion for Vietnamese women. Through passion and relentless innovation, CCHAT has achieved remarkable milestones:

items.2021-now: Rapid expansion to 20+ locations nationwide, cementing our position as a leader in women's fashion

vision.part3: and where every team member finds

customerValue.title: CUSTOMER VALUE
customerValue.description: At CCHAT, customers are at the heart of everything we do. We deliver value through:
customerValue.conclusion: These pillars enable CCHAT to go beyond selling clothes – we create memorable shopping experiences for Vietnamese women.

coreValue.title: CORE VALUES
coreValue.intro: Four foundational values guide every member of the CCHAT team:

integrity.title: INTEGRITY
integrity.desc: Honesty in thought, word, and action

coreValue.conclusion: These values shape a passionate team committed to delivering exceptional products and outstanding service.

brandManifesto.title: BRAND MANIFESTO
brandManifesto.paragraph1: We believe that every woman carries within her a unique beauty. CCHAT exists to awaken that beauty - in a delicate, gentle, and inspiring way.
brandManifesto.paragraph2: We don't create clothes just to wear. We create designs for women to confidently step into life, to smile when they look in the mirror, and to feel they deserve better things every day.
brandManifesto.paragraph3: CCHAT fashion is a blend of elegance – youthfulness – modernity - versatile application. CCHAT products are perfected with quality materials and meticulous cuts to flatter every body type.
brandManifesto.paragraph4: We believe in gentle transformation: just one suitable design is enough to change the mood of an entire day. To help you stand taller, walk more confidently, and live more vibrantly.
brandManifesto.conclusion: CCHAT — where your true beauty is awakened through creativity and inspiration!

brandStory.title: BRAND STORY
brandStory.question: CCHAT began with a simple question: What makes a woman feel truly beautiful?
brandStory.paragraph1: Not expensive items. Not chasing trends. But the moment they wear a design that makes them see themselves – feeling younger, more confident, and experiencing small but real joy.
brandStory.paragraph2: From that moment, CCHAT was born.
brandStory.paragraph3: We chose the path of sophistication and creativity: Elegant, gentle designs with unique accents - different enough for you to feel special, practical enough to wear every day.
brandStory.paragraph4: Each CCHAT product is created from: quality materials, flattering cuts, and design thinking aimed at making women always feel their most beautiful version.
brandStory.paragraph5: CCHAT believes that fashion is not just what you wear. It's how you tell your own story — a story of confidence, happiness, and inspiration.
brandStory.conclusionPart1: We only play a small role: helping you
brandStory.conclusionHighlight: shine in your own unique way

section1.title: PURPOSE OF COLLECTING AND USING
section1.subtitle: INFORMATION BY CCHAT
section1.cardText: CCHAT primarily collects basic customer information related to orders including:
section1.cardHighlight: Full name, email, phone number, address
section1.description: This personal information is used for order processing on the website, improving service quality, customer care, market research, supporting Marketing activities, internal management, or as required by law

commitments.item1: Collection and use of personal information is always done with customer consent
commitments.item2: Customer information is used only for the intended collection purposes
commitments.item3: Customer information will be stored until requested for deletion by admin; all other personal information will be secured on CCHAT servers.
commitments.item4: We only use information provided by customers and do not use customer information from other sources.
commitments.item5: Only the following parties are allowed access to customer information: Company employees (those who process orders, provide customer care, and handle inquiries and issues), and authorized government agencies

section1.footer: During product introduction, advertising, and customer care, customers may request to stop the use of their information at any time.

section2.title: INFORMATION SECURITY METHODS
section2.subtitle: OF CCHAT
section2.description: Information security is based on compliance by all CCHAT staff, employees, partners, and data storage systems. In case of server attacks by hackers leading to data loss or leakage, we will report to authorities for investigation and promptly notify affected customers.
section2.disclaimer: However, due to the nature of the internet environment, no data can be 100% secure online. Therefore, CCHAT cannot guarantee absolute protection of personal information.

section3.title: CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITY FOR
section3.subtitle: INFORMATION SECURITY
section3.description1: Customers should only provide complete and accurate information as requested by CCHAT. Customers are fully responsible for the truthfulness and accuracy of provided information, as well as any information provided beyond requirements.
section3.description2: If customers provide their personal information to multiple organizations or individuals, customers must request all related parties to maintain confidentiality. For any personal information disclosure causing damage, customers must identify the source of the leak.
section3.disclaimer1: CCHAT is not responsible for information disclosure without clear evidence that CCHAT is the source of the leak.
section3.disclaimer2: Customers are responsible for securing their login accounts on CCHAT e-commerce platforms and applications
section3.disclaimer3: We are not responsible for information leakage when customers do not comply with the above requirements

section4.title: APPLICABLE LAW FOR
section4.subtitle: DISPUTES
section4.description: All disputes between customers and CCHAT will be resolved through mediation. If mediation fails, disputes will be resolved at the competent court under Vietnamese law

q1.question: How do I place an order on CCHAT?
q1.answer:
You can place an order by following these steps:
1. Select a product and add it to your cart
2. Click on the cart and review your order
3. Fill in shipping information
4. Choose a payment method
5. Confirm your order
After successful ordering, you will receive an email/SMS confirmation.

q2.question: Can I cancel or modify my order?
q2.answer: You can cancel or modify your order within 2 hours after placing it by contacting hotline 0868 506 800. Once the order has been processed and handed over to the shipping carrier, changes cannot be made.

q3.question: How do I check my order status?
q3.answer:
You can check your order status by:
- Logging into your account and going to "My Orders"
- Using the tracking number sent via SMS/email to track on the carrier's website
- Contacting hotline 0868 506 800 for assistance

q1.question: What payment methods does CCHAT accept?
q1.answer:
CCHAT accepts the following payment methods:
- COD (Cash on Delivery)
- Bank transfer
- E-wallets (MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay)
- Credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard)

q2.question: Is payment on CCHAT secure?
q2.answer: All online payments on CCHAT are SSL encrypted and processed through reputable payment gateways. We do not store customer credit card information.

q3.question: Can I get a VAT invoice?
q3.answer: Yes, CCHAT supports VAT invoice issuance for orders. Please provide company information when ordering or contact the hotline within 24 hours after receiving your order to request an invoice.

q1.question: How long does shipping take?
q1.answer:
Shipping times:
- Within Hanoi, HCMC: 1-2 days
- Other provinces: 3-5 days
Times may be longer during holidays or due to unforeseen circumstances.

q2.question: How much is the shipping fee?
q2.answer:
Shipping fees depend on the area and order value:
- Free shipping when purchasing 2 or more products
- Orders under 2 products: shipping fee from 20,000đ - 40,000đ depending on area

q3.question: Can I choose a delivery time?
q3.answer: Currently, CCHAT does not support choosing specific delivery time slots. The delivery person will contact you before delivery to confirm. If you are not available, the order will be delivered again on the next business day.

q1.question: What is CCHAT's return policy?
q1.answer:
CCHAT applies a return policy within 7 days from the date of receipt with the following conditions:
- Product has not been used, still has tags and labels
- Has invoice or order information
- Does not apply to products on sale 50% or more

q2.question: How do I exchange a product size?
q2.answer:
To exchange size, please:
1. Contact hotline 0868 506 800 within 7 days from the date of receipt
2. Pack the product carefully and send it to the store address
3. CCHAT will send back the new size product within 3-5 days
Size exchange shipping fee: Free for the first time

q3.question: When will I receive my refund?
q3.answer:
After CCHAT receives and inspects the returned product:
- Refund via bank account: 5-7 business days
- Refund via e-wallet: 1-3 business days
- Exchange for another product: sent within 3-5 days

q1.question: How do I choose the right size?
q1.answer:
CCHAT provides a detailed size chart for each product. You should:
1. View the size chart in the product description
2. Measure your body and compare with the size chart
3. Refer to the size guide on the website
If still unsure, please contact the hotline for advice.

q2.question: How should I care for the products?
q2.answer:
To keep products looking great:
- Machine wash on gentle cycle, cold water
- Do not use strong bleach
- Dry in shade, avoid direct sunlight
- Iron at low temperature, inside out
Refer to the care instructions on the product label.

q3.question: Do CCHAT products have warranty?
q3.answer: CCHAT warrants products in case of manufacturer defects (stitching, zippers, buttons...) within 30 days from the date of purchase. Warranty does not cover damage due to improper use.

q1.question: How do I register an account?
q1.answer:
You can register a CCHAT account by:
1. Click on the account icon on the website
2. Select "Register"
3. Fill in information: full name, email, phone number, password
4. Confirm via email/SMS
Or register quickly with Facebook account.

q2.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
q2.answer:
To recover your password:
1. Click "Forgot password" on the login page
2. Enter your registered email
3. Check your email and click the reset link
4. Create a new password
If you don't receive the email, check your spam folder or contact the hotline.

q3.question: What is CCHAT's VIP program?
q3.answer:
CCHAT VIP Program:
- Earn 1% points on order value
- Points can be exchanged for discount vouchers
- VIP members get early sale access, birthday gifts
- See details on the VIP Policy page
